background.text: Today, I think it was a relatively happy Tuesday, everything being relative. I don't think, by the time, the average person who isn't really in and out of the market as a trader, by the time they, sort of become nervous about this, jobs aren't stopping, record earnings are reported in today's papers, third quarters have been wonderful. I think the recovery will be quick. I think what we had is a solar plexus, and a lot of people are out of wind, but it's not lethal.
